name: Naledi
face: Young Motswana girl with warm deep-brown skin, a round face, dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright smile.
clothing: White leteisi dress with large red and blue flowers, a blue lattice, short puffed sleeves, a blue sash tied in a bow, and a blue hem. Blue, red, and white patterned doek. Small gold hoop earrings, a short gold bead necklace, and brown sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Floral doek wrapped close to the head, gold hoops and bead necklace, blue sash bow, and the red-and-blue flowers on the white dress.
